description: The front searches products through a new endpoint, GET /produtos/busca?nome=, which answers 200 with the same list. The page shows the right product; the endpoint the test checks is never called.
note: Either the move is intended and the test should check the new endpoint, or the front called the wrong one. The evidence shows both runs: GET /produtos?nome= in the passing one, GET /produtos/busca?nome= with the same answer shape in the failing one. Only a human can choose.
